author: Yffe
content:
Fix #259: doc-drift.py exits 0 on an EMPTY route table (vacuous green), violating REQ-9 ('The tool never exits 0 without having checked all 48 docs' — an empty enumeration source means NOTHING was checked, hence INCONCLUSIVE exit 3) and goal.md R-HONEST-3.

Root cause: load_doc_files() returns {} for a zero-route table; evaluate() then loops over an empty dict, leaves failed=False, and returns EXIT_OK with no report. Zero docs checked is collapsed to a green pass.

Minimal single-file fix (tooling/doc-drift.py): in load_doc_files(), after inverting routes, if the resulting doc->files map is empty, raise EnvironmentError3 (an empty route table yields nothing to check; fail-open is forbidden, R-HONEST-3). This routes the condition through the existing EnvironmentError3 -> exit 3 path with a loud stderr message. Scoped strictly to the empty case; the wrong-shape/traceback case is #260 and is NOT touched here.

Test edit (allowed as part of closing the pin): ungate test_c1 ONLY in tooling/tests/test_doc_drift_critic.py (remove its skipUnless), leaving test_c2 skip-gated for #260.

Gauntlet: python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v (test_c1 runs+passes, test_c2 skipped, builder's 10 green); python3 tooling/doc-drift.py live (still exit 1, 48 MISSING-PIN + 1 DRIFT, unchanged); git diff scripts/audit.sh empty.
